editorial: Your eyelids will bob to the slow-burn silence as a hitman’s steel-cold precision cracks open a quiet heart. The uncanny twist is that when the contract target turns into a forbidden love, the assassin abandons his lethal creed and becomes a reluctant recruit. The standout is Joaquin Phoenix’s almost silent performance, letting silence carry the emotional weight amid the film’s grim visuals. Ideal for fans who relish psychological thrillers with non-linear storytelling and a predatory undercurrent. A minor flaw is a mid-run pacing lull that thins the tension before the climax, but it quickly regains momentum.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
